summary: Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited furnished a Form 6-K on 30 October 2026 confirming it filed its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026 with the US SEC, the South African issuer's equivalent of an annual filing on a US domestic form. No transaction, price, stake, premium, or recommendation is disclosed; the notice simply directs shareholders to the report on the company website and the SEC site. Sponsor is J.P. Morgan Equities South Africa. This is routine annual reporting, not a special situation; watch only for any subsequent strategic or corporate-action disclosures
